summary: Media migration to external server (files.ihgbrands.com/brightluxx) testing completed. Hero videos in Home.js now use external CDN URLs. CDN endpoint correctly redirects standard image requests (302) to external server and handles image transformations (w, h, q, f params). All 72 product images and 26 project images load correctly via CDN.

minor.issue: Cache-Control headers set in backend code are overridden by Kubernetes proxy layer (shows 'no-store, no-cache' instead of 'public, max-age=31536000'). Not a bug - expected behavior in preview environment.
